ev_tree_canopy_cover_sprenkle24_1.note: Sprenkle-Hyppolite PDF p4 Geospatial data processing: 25% separates agricultural and forestry NCS accounting and avoids distinguishing high-shade agroforestry from natural forests. Source explicitly allows agriculture above 25%. Removed executable threshold. Require evidence of trees within agricultural land before spatial aggregation; coarse forest/crop mixture is insufficient.

ev_T4_precip_haile2024_2.note: Haile Table 3 (PDF pp4-5) ranks >1200 mm Very high, above the 800-1200 mm High class. Removed false optimum plateau. <600 mm is Low, not excluded. Preserve ranks and regional context; family applicability and membership mapping remain unresolved.

ev_soildepth_inab_p92_aa_example.note: INAB PDF p92 Photo 8 describes one site. Aa is a land-capability allocation class (definition p27; matrices pp29-35 include shallower soils). Removed false 90 cm absolute minimum; retained observed site context. No inference from effective soil depth to a universal bedrock limit.

EV_researchsquare_fmnr_2025_001.note: PDF p5 Results defines a Sahel cropland reconstruction domain (300-800 mm), not physiological limits. Removed hard bounds; retained study domain. Proposed semi-arid Sahel FMNR scope is a separate pending methodology decision.

EV_wocat_1358_2017_003.note: WOCAT PDF p4 Natural Environment describes the documented site: selected flat (0-2%) checkbox. It does not state that FMNR cannot work on steeper land. Removed shape parameters and retained observation; family applicability remains unconfirmed.
